description: Only films whose running time is strictly more than 112 minutes are included; a film of exactly 112 minutes does not count.

c.request: Using 112 minutes (`film.length`) as the cutoff for a long film and considering only the long films, for each language (`film.language_id`) give the language id, the average replacement cost (`replacement_cost`), and the average running time, ignoring missing values in each average (missing if none remain). Sort by average running time from highest to lowest, with missing averages last, show the top 10, and don't round. Only films whose running time is strictly more than 112 minutes are included; a film of exactly 112 minutes does not count.
c.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_length IS NULL, avg_length DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Only films with `film.length` strictly greater than 112 minutes (exactly 112 excluded) are counted as long; for each `film.language_id` among them, return the language id, the average `replacement_cost` and the average `length`, both ignoring NULLs (NULL if none remain), sorted by average length descending with NULL averages last, top 10, unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY (AVG(length) IS NULL) ASC, AVG(length) DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: Looking only at films whose running time (`film.length`) is more than 112 minutes, for each language (`film.language_id`) give the language id, the average replacement cost (`replacement_cost`), and the average running time, ignoring missing values in each average (missing if none remain). Sort by average running time from highest to lowest, with missing averages last, show the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY (AVG(length) IS NULL) ASC, AVG(length) DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For films with length strictly greater than 112 minutes (excluding films of exactly 112), group by language_id and return the language_id, the average replacement_cost and the average length (NULLs ignored in each average, NULL if no values remain), ordered by average length descending with NULL averages last, limited to the top 10, with no rounding.
b.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY (AVG(length) IS NULL) ASC, AVG(length) DESC LIMIT 10
